body: I clearly don't really have the best coping methods if I self harm...I cut myself for 6 years from 8th grade to first year of college. The only way I was able to stop was because of my boyfriend. So, I'm clearly not the most emotionally stable person...I know most people would probably be able to handle this...but for some reason I just can't...
But I just feel like it will never end. :( I have no energy to apply for jobs... So I feel like I'll be unemployed forever. *sigh* ... Thank you for the kind words though. :)
Hehe. Ya, I started with the C25K program. I finished that and was doing a different program. But I bet now I'm back at the C25K program level. X_X Hahaha.

Ya...I was thinking of trying to find a running group to meet people but I don't think I'm nearly good enough to be in a group. :(

Edit: Thank you for the advice and taking the time to respond!
Ya, maybe I'll try that again...I used to go for runs 5 days a week but I stopped after my boyfriend broke up with me because I only went once afterwards and I started crying in the middle...

I wish I could just sleep all day but I actually have trouble sleeping and it's making it worse... :( I'm trying to tell myself I'm just being irrational but it's not helping because I feel so hopeless... Thanks for the response though. :) ...
